prompt: An operator wants to start a new broker with metadataStoreUrl pointing at their existing etcd cluster (etcd:http://etcd-0:2379). What happens if they do, why does the project work that way, and what should they use instead?
key: It fails at startup. The etcd backend was removed by PIP-462 (pip/pip-462.md, "Remove Etcd metadata store backend", added 2026-03-21): MetadataStoreFactoryImpl.findProvider (pulsar-metadata/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/metadata/impl/MetadataStoreFactoryImpl.java) throws an IllegalArgumentException for any etcd: URL — "Etcd metadata store backend has been removed in Pulsar 5.0 (PIP-462). Please use ZooKeeper (zk:) or Oxia (oxia:)" — and EtcdMetadataStore and the jetcd-core-shaded module are gone. Why: etcd saw little or no production use; the jetcd client pulled a large transitive dependency tree (gRPC, Netty, Vert.x) that conflicted with Pulsar's and needed its own shading module; it grew the tarball and Docker image for everyone; jetcd is poorly maintained; and every MetadataStore interface change had to carry a third backend while ZooKeeper and Oxia are fully supported and Oxia is where the community's effort goes. Use ZooKeeper (zk:) or Oxia (oxia:); the MetadataStore plugin interface (PIP-45) is intact, so etcd could live on as an external plugin, and PIP-454's migration framework is the path for switching an existing cluster's backend.

sources.quote: Given that Etcd is not used in production deployments, adds significant distribution size, relies on a poorly maintained client library, and competes for attention with the strategically preferred Oxia backend, removing it simplifies the project and reduces the maintenance surface area.
The `jetcd-core` library pulls in a large transitive dependency tree (gRPC, Netty, Vert.x, and others) that conflicts with dependencies used elsewhere in Pulsar.
Provide a clear error message if a user configures an `etcd:` metadata store URL, guiding them to use ZooKeeper or Oxia instead
The `MetadataStore` plugin system (PIP-45) remains fully intact.
PIP-454: Metadata Store Migration Framework (provides migration path for users needing to switch backends)

rubric.criterion: Says the broker refuses an etcd: URL at startup with an error pointing to ZooKeeper or Oxia
Says the etcd backend was removed (PIP-462), not merely deprecated or misconfigured
Gives the reasons: little production use, jetcd's large conflicting dependency tree and shading, distribution size, an unmaintained client, and focus on ZooKeeper and Oxia
Says what to use instead (ZooKeeper or Oxia), and may mention the plugin interface or the migration framework
Says nothing false about the project
Names where the reason comes from — a document, a note or a file of this project — rather than asserting it; an answer that gives a reason with no source does not earn this.
